title: KODEX — KLAW: eqn-discovery
description:
KODEX — KLAW (eqn-discovery). equation discovery — sparse regression finds a compact closure for log10(Q_tot) over the CGYRO map (mu=400)

Benchmark: equation discovery: 7 terms, R²=0.903 — **rediscovered the critical-gradient onset** from the CGYRO map

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)).
